lines.zh: 我在林子里走，脚不落地。
lines.en: I walk the woods without touching ground.

lines.zh: 我的腿太长，走起来一折一折。
lines.en: My legs are too long; they fold and unfold.

lines.zh: 我贴着树干过去，皮都擦掉了。
lines.en: I slide past a trunk and leave bark behind.
I pause after every step to listen.

lines.zh: 我绕过营地，从下风处走。
lines.en: I circle the camp from downwind.

lines.zh: 我的肋骨在皮下面支棱着。
lines.en: My ribs push against my hide.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，慢得像不会动。
lines.en: I move so slowly I might not be moving.
There are no prints in the snow where I pass.

lines.zh: 我沿着鹿道走，那里更好走。
lines.en: I follow the deer trail. Better footing.

lines.zh: 我听到人的声音，就往那边去。
lines.en: I hear voices and head that way.

lines.zh: 树林里的枝条都躲着我。
lines.en: The branches in these woods shrink from me.

lines.zh: 我走了大半夜，天还没亮。
lines.en: I've walked half the night and it's still dark.

lines.zh: 我蹲在一棵枯树后面，不动。
lines.en: I crouch behind a dead tree and hold still.
I smell people. Very near.
I'm swallowing, slowly.

lines.zh: 我的头会自己转，看别处。
lines.en: My head turns of its own accord.
Snow settles on my back and doesn't melt.
I put out my tongue and wet my teeth.
I'm waiting for the lights in the house to go out.

lines.zh: 我的手指在地上刨出一道。
lines.en: My fingers scrape a line in the ground.
Someone's chopping wood deep in the trees.
When the wind shifts, I move.
I'm counting the prints in the snow.
A crow calls, and I look up.
I wet my lips. So dry.

lines.zh: 这具身体，饿起来连自己都咬。
lines.en: When this body gets hungry, it would bite itself.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，比树还像树。
lines.en: I stay so still I look more like a tree than a tree.
I hear someone counting logs.
I sink lower. Easier to hide.

lines.zh: 冬天把人关在屋里，很好。
lines.en: Winter keeps people indoors. Good.
You smell of the inside of a house.

lines.zh: 你走得这么慢，是怕我吗？
lines.en: You walk so slowly. Afraid of me?
There's a pulse in your neck.
I'm not in a hurry. I'll wait for full dark.
That torch of yours is nearly done.
Your walking rhythm in the forest.
Are your companions inside?
I'm looking at your fingers.
Your voice shakes when you speak.

lines.zh: 我这张脸，你不太敢看吧。
lines.en: You don't quite dare look at this face.

lines.zh: 这林子里的路，我比你熟。
lines.en: I know these paths better than you.

lines.zh: 你退后，我就当你要跑了。
lines.en: Step back and I'll take it for a run.
I make a sound that isn't human.

lines.zh: 这一下打中我的肋，很空。
lines.en: That hit my ribs. Hollow.
I give two steps and crouch.

lines.zh: 我的皮裂了，里面没什么血。
lines.en: My hide split, and there's little blood.
I don't fear pain. I fear not eating enough.
I lick the wound and look up again.
That only made me hungrier.
I brace on a trunk and straighten.

lines.zh: 你听到了吗？那是我的骨头。
lines.en: Did you hear that? That was my bones.
Noted. Your hand is heavy.
Set the meat down. Don't hold it up.

lines.zh: 你递来的肉太少，只够舔一舔。
lines.en: The meat you offer is so little, barely a lick.

lines.zh: 血味从你袖口透出来，很甜。
lines.en: Blood seeps from your cuff; it smells sweet.
I'm coming over. You should move back.
Eating that will make me hungrier.

lines.zh: 食物在你手里，这是问题。
lines.en: The food's in your hand. That's the problem.

lines.zh: 你把袋子扔过来，扔远些。
lines.en: Throw the bag. Farther.
I'm watching your hand, not the meat.

lines.zh: 我不挑，饿起来什么都不挑。
lines.en: I'm not picky. Hungry, I'm not picky at all.
Two steps back, then I'll go.
You hit my ribs. Sharp, aren't they.

lines.zh: 我几乎没有重量，一碰就晃。
lines.en: I weigh almost nothing; a touch sways me.

lines.zh: 这一下你摸到了皮，不是布。
lines.en: You've touched hide, not cloth.
Don't press against me. There are insects on me.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，脚没发出声。
lines.en: I give a step, and my foot makes no sound.
Your hand came back fast.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，你比我先退。
lines.en: We collided, and you gave first.

lines.zh: 烟花能挡我一会儿，只有一会儿。
lines.en: Fireworks stop me briefly. Briefly.

lines.zh: 我在你身边站着，你却没察觉。
lines.en: I stood beside you and you never noticed.

lines.zh: 你踩到了我的脚，像踩到树枝。
lines.en: You stepped on my foot. Like stepping on a branch.
I only want to feed.
That isn't what my body wants.
Come close and you're a meal.
There are others of my kind in these woods.
Winter has left me with nothing but hunger.
I can't be gentle. I can't.

lines.zh: 你把火把举着，我靠近不了。
lines.en: Keep the torch up and I can't come closer.
I don't remember such a thing.
I'd rather hear you scream.
When the snow melts. Perhaps.

lines.zh: 我捡起一根骨头，嚼了嚼。
lines.en: I pick up a bone and gnaw it.
The meat's frozen hard. I'll eat it anyway.

lines.zh: 我把东西塞进嘴里再说。
lines.en: I put it in my mouth first, then decide.

lines.zh: 地上这截肠子，我不放过。
lines.en: That scrap of gut on the ground. Mine.

lines.zh: 这块布上的味道，走过林子。
lines.en: This cloth smells of someone who crossed the woods.
Something's moving. I pin it.
I hide the bone in a hollow.
I bite into this iron thing.
I grip it and my nails sink in.
That's not enough for one meal.
You're alone. Good.

lines.zh: 树枝被我拨开，我弯着腰出来。
lines.en: I push the branches aside and stoop out.
Did you hear that branch snap?

lines.zh: 这片林子，今晚只有我们。
lines.en: Tonight it's only us in these woods.
I've fixed on your back.

lines.zh: 你的火光挡不了我多久。
lines.en: Your torch won't hold me long.
Step by step behind you — no hurry.

lines.zh: 你走进来的时候，我就选了。
lines.en: I chose you when you walked in.

lines.zh: 你的气味在这片雪地上散开。
lines.en: Your scent spreads across this snow.
I want to hear you cry out.
I don't chase. I walk ahead of you.

lines.zh: 你在雪上留下的路，太清楚。
lines.en: Your trail in the snow is far too clear.
You stopped. So did I.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的营地转了半圈。
lines.en: I've made half a circle of your camp.
Your companions won't come for you.

lines.zh: 这林子的每棵树我都认得。
lines.en: I know every tree in this wood.
The torch will burn out eventually.
Go north and you'll find a dead end.
I follow inside your shadow.

lines.zh: 你每喘一口，我都听得见。
lines.en: I hear every breath you take.
My hand closes on your shoulder.
That split your skin open.
Fireworks only made me step back.

lines.zh: 你举火把，我退一下再上。
lines.en: You raise the torch; I pull back and come again.
I come down from above onto you.

lines.zh: 你被拖进雪里，抓不住东西。
lines.en: You're dragged into the snow, nothing to grip.

lines.zh: 我的长指扣住你的肩，往回扯。
lines.en: My long fingers hook your shoulder and pull back.
I'm laughing. You can't tell.

lines.zh: 你踢我，我的身体太轻了。
lines.en: You kick me; I'm far too light.

lines.zh: 这一下，你手里的火把掉了。
lines.en: That knocked the torch from your hand.
There's one more shadow in the woods.

lines.zh: 雪停下的时候，我站了起来。
lines.en: When the snow stopped, I stood up.

lines.zh: 我在树与树之间，慢慢成形。
lines.en: Between the trees, I slowly take shape.

lines.zh: 雪落在我的角上，我不擦。
lines.en: Snow settles on my antlers; I don't brush it off.

lines.zh: 我蹲在屋脊上，没发出声音。
lines.en: I crouch on the roof without a sound.

lines.zh: 有人在这片林子里迷了路。
lines.en: Someone's lost in these woods.

lines.zh: 我从雪堆里爬出来，抖落雪。
lines.en: I crawl out of a drift and shake off snow.

lines.zh: 这地区太安静，我来补上。
lines.en: This area's too quiet. I'll fix that.

lines.zh: 树枝上的雪被我碰落了。
lines.en: I knock the snow off a branch.
I stand at the treeline, waiting for someone.
This body has been hungry a long time.
Winter brought me here.

lines.zh: 火一碰，我的皮就缩起来。
lines.en: Fire touches me and my hide draws back.

lines.zh: 我从树上摔下，落地没有声音。
lines.en: I fall from the tree and land silently.

lines.zh: 水灌进我，我还在往前走。
lines.en: Water fills me, and I keep walking.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀到树上，我挂在枝间。
lines.en: The blast throws me into a tree; I hang in the branches.

lines.zh: 箭穿过肩胛，我低头看了看洞。
lines.en: The arrow goes through my shoulder blade; I look at the hole.

lines.zh: 那股力压着我，我讨厌它。
lines.en: That force bears down on me. I hate it.

lines.zh: 饿到了极点，我连痛都感觉不到。
lines.en: This hungry, I can't even feel pain.

lines.zh: 雷劈在树上，我整身一颤。
lines.en: Lightning hits a tree and I shudder all over.
I fall, still biting at the air.
